Grain
Over a Century of Grain Industry Experience.
Since 1913, farmers have relied on our family to cultivate solutions for their operations. Our long-standing relationships, deep market knowledge, and commitment to service make us a reliable resource for local producers year after year.
As an industry leader in agricultural exports , we offer a comprehensive commercial grain and food-grade program designed to meet the evolving needs of both growers and end-users. Our network of strategically located country grain elevators and export facilities spans Wisconsin, Illinois, Kansas, Nebraska, Michigan, New Jersey, and New York, providing essential grain handling, storage, and marketing support close to where our customers need it most.
Our commercial grain business focuses on buying, storing, and marketing corn, soybeans, and wheat sourced directly from local farmers. These grains are then delivered to a wide range of domestic millers and livestock feeders, as well as exported to global markets, helping connect American agriculture to the world.
In addition, our grain division offers grain marketing solutions for enhanced profitability and risk management. Learn more about our array of contracts and marketing options through your local DeLong merchandiser or by contacting our Yield365 team.
Cash Bids. Account Details. Contracts. All in the palm of your hand.
The DeLong Co. Grain Portal
Let’s Talk Specialty Programs.
Since the early 1980s, we have been supplying food processors worldwide with high quality food grade products . Food grade white and yellow corn is cleaned and processed in Clinton, WI and sold domestically to snack and food manufacturers in bulk and bags. We sell food corn internationally to Europe, Asia, Mexico, and Canada. Food grade soybeans are processed and shipped domestically and loaded on barges and containers for export.
Our high oleic soybean program is now open. Click below to learn more.
DeLong High Oleic Soybean Program
Let’s Talk Grain Bids by Text.
Get live cash bids for corn, soybeans, wheat, and specialty crops sent straight to your phone. Tell us what you grow, and we’ll text you offers that fit, with the price and pickup window up front. Reply to accept, pass, or counter. No phone tag, no waiting on a callback, just current prices when they’re ready for you.
Sign up below to start getting bids by text.
Sign Up for Text Bids
Let’s Talk Profitability.
Our Yield 365 division is focused on enhancing your grain operation’s profitability and risk management – 365 days a year.
Yield 365 takes an easy, educational approach to customizing your portfolio. Through a simple Discovery – Develop – Deliver process, we keep the typically overwhelming task of marketing your grain as simple as possible.
Contact Kasey at kasey.baker@delongcompany.com !
